title: SWRL forward chaining
description: For every SWRL rule whose antecedent matches the current model, fire the consequent. Antecedent atom types: class / objectProperty / dataProperty / builtin (six numeric comparators) / sameAs / differentFrom. The default KB classifies a transaction as HighValue if its amount ≥ 10000. Try changing the amount, or add another rule into the model-swrl block.
